entries.title: Bilingual Hindi-English Storytime / द्विभाषी हिंदी-अंग्रेज़ी कहानी समय
entries.description: This special Storytime helps children strengthen their language comprehension skills while enjoying traditional rhymes and stories from the Indian culture. \nOffered monthly, this engaging program is aimed for kids ages 3-10 and their families, but all ages and language abilities are welcome to join!

entries.title: Turkey Toss!
entries.description: No, not real turkeys because domestic Turkeys can’t fly, as illustrated in the famous WKRP episode, so we will be dropping little soft, squeezable Turkeys that the kids can take home with them.

entries.title: Reading to Children

entries.title: Family Movie Club: Wonder

entries.title: Glider Discovery

entries.description: Bring your guitar, ukulele, voice, or any fun instruments you have been practicing to perform in an open mic setting.

entries.title: Straw Rocket Workshop

entries.title: LEGO Club
